verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a Registrar API for searching, registering and managing domains, but nothing documents create/update/delete of DNS records. The only hint is a community comment that third-party DNS changes require a full-access Cloudflare account API key. That points to the separate Cloudflare DNS platform the registrar depends on, not a documented capability of the Registrar itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, DNS records are CRUD-able via a documented API — create, update, and delete records programmatically for automation and ACME challenges
